player_0.content: New plan: I failed to visit the "Bedroom" because I got stuck in an infinite loop between the Pantry, Guest room, and Closet, repeatedly moving north and south without ever attempting the available "west" direction. Although the graph structure was correct, the strategy of only exploring the currently available directions (which were all already visited) prevented me from discovering new nodes. Next time, I will strictly check the list of available directions at every step; if a direction leads to a room I have already visited, I will immediately try the next available direction instead of repeating the same path. I will ensure that I do not output "DONE" until I have explicitly confirmed that all available directions lead to previously visited rooms and no new rooms remain reachable.
